method: Each published field is linked to a dated source identifier. Lifecycle labels are analyst classifications of the cited operating evidence, not price forecasts. No cross-collection floor, volume, or holder comparison is asserted where units or snapshots are not comparable.

profile.founder_engagement: Nouns governance documentation remains published; proposals are voted on by Noun holders and delegates.
profile.benefits: One Noun is generated and auctioned every 24 hours; auction proceeds are deposited to the DAO treasury controlled by Noun owners.
profile.analysis: Classified thriving on continued protocol-defined daily auctions and documented holder governance, not on a secondary-market price claim. The supply is intentionally open-ended, so scarcity comparisons with fixed-supply PFP collections are inapposite.

profile.royalties_enforced: Operator announced royalties would be set to 0% as operations wound down.
profile.founder_engagement: The team ended further development and open-sourced smart-contract code and block data; NFT ownership remained with holders.
profile.analysis: A clean shutdown case, not a rug-pull attribution: the team stated that engagement had fallen about 96% year over year, Battles did not reach expected engagement, and ongoing operations would cease. The NFT contracts and assets surviving does not mean the game business survived. This separates asset persistence from operating-product durability.
